name: paddle-hit
prompt: Short punchy thwack of a hollow rubber paddle striking a hard plastic ball, tight attack with a faint high-pitched ring, indoor court acoustics

name: wall-bounce
prompt: Dull low thud of a small hard ball bouncing off a padded arena wall, quick decay, minimal echo

name: bumper-bounce
prompt: Springy rounded boing of a ball rebounding off a rubber bumper, playful elastic tone with a quick pitch rise

name: serve-launch
prompt: Quick rising whoosh of a ball being launched across a table, airy sweep ending in a soft snap

name: serve-ready
prompt: Single soft mallet tap on a wooden block, clean and brief, a gentle ready cue

name: goal-scored
prompt: Bright celebratory chime burst with a short crowd-free sparkle, ascending metallic ping resolving warmly

name: match-end
prompt: Decisive final buzzer followed by a resonant gong swell, conclusive end-of-match punctuation fading to silence

name: invalid-action
prompt: Low muted double honk of a rubber error buzzer, soft and short, clearly negative but not harsh

name: ui-click
prompt: Crisp short click of a small plastic button being pressed, dry and immediate

name: ui-back
prompt: Soft reverse tap, a gentle hollow wooden knock slightly lower and rounder than a confirm click

name: ui-open
prompt: Light ascending paper-and-glass swoosh of a panel sliding open, airy and brief

name: ui-error
prompt: Short descending muted electronic blip of a denied input, soft plastic buzz, one quick pulse

name: ui-unlock
prompt: Bright two-note metallic key-turn and latch release, satisfying mechanical unlock with a light chime tail

name: ui-star
prompt: Delicate high glass-bell sparkle, a single shimmering star twinkle with fine crystalline decay

name: countdown-tick
prompt: Dry wooden metronome tick, one precise short knock for a countdown beat

name: countdown-go
prompt: Sharp bright starting whistle chirp, short and energetic, signaling go

name: undo-rewind
prompt: Quick soft tape-rewind zip, a brief descending flutter like a page flipped backward
